olderBrother.face: rounded-square East Asian child face, fair/light skin, dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, small rounded nose, soft cheeks
olderBrother.hair: short dark-brown blocky hair with the same neat side-swept silhouette
olderBrother.outfit: cream hoodie, light-green adventure vest, tan shorts, white sneakers, small green wristband, square backpack with a plain checkpoint-shaped badge with no letters

youngerBrother.face: rounder East Asian child face, fair/light skin, slightly larger dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, small rounded nose, fuller soft cheeks
youngerBrother.hair: short dark-brown blocky hair with the same slightly fluffy front silhouette
youngerBrother.outfit: white shirt, bright-blue adventure hoodie, navy shorts, blue-and-white sneakers, small blue utility pouch with a plain compass-shaped charm with no letters

pairRules: older brother must always be visibly taller than younger brother
never swap faces, hair, outfit, props, colors or height relationship
never create a third brother or duplicate either character
never age up or age down either brother
never switch which brother is speaking
never render character names, usernames, floating labels, chat bubbles, health bars or readable text near either character

sceneGenerationContract.scene1: Use CHARACTER_SHEETS as the primary identity reference and establish canonical faces/outfits clearly.
sceneGenerationContract.scene2Plus: Use CHARACTER_SHEETS for identity AND the immediately previous generated scene image as the mandatory continuity reference.
sceneGenerationContract.referenceOrder: identity from character sheet first; pose/position/lighting/obstacle state from previous scene second; location sheet third
sceneGenerationContract.startFrameRule: Scene N+1 must begin from the physical state of Scene N end frame unless an explicit transition scene changes location.
sceneGenerationContract.endFrameRule: Every scene must define a continuityEndFrame describing character positions, prop inventory, obstacle state, camera direction and next-action setup.
sceneGenerationContract.screenDirectionRule: Preserve left/right travel direction and brother positions unless the action visibly crosses or turns them.
sceneGenerationContract.propRule: Props persist until visibly picked up, dropped, consumed or left behind.
sceneGenerationContract.obstacleRule: Completed obstacles stay completed; activated buttons, bridges, doors, vehicles and puzzle states cannot reset without an explicit story reason.
sceneGenerationContract.locationTransitionRule: No teleporting. A location change requires a portal, doorway, vehicle ride, climb, elevator, corridor or other visible transition beat.
sceneGenerationContract.dialogueRule: At most one speaker per scene. The non-speaker keeps mouth closed and reacts naturally.
sceneGenerationContract.cameraRule: Camera movement must follow the same physical space and cannot reset character positions between scenes.

storyStateContract.invariant: continuityEndFrame(scene N) == continuityStartState(scene N+1) in all meaningful physical details
storyStateContract.episodeRule: Each episode is one continuous adventure with a clear start, escalation, payoff and complete ending inside the episode.

generationStopConditions: scene begins from a different obstacle/location state than previous end frame
prop disappears or appears without explanation
camera orientation causes impossible teleport or obstacle reset
